    AI Overview
    The official application for 2027 Masters tickets opens on June 1, 2026, and closes on June 20, 2026, via the official Masters website. Applicants can enter a lottery for practice rounds ($125–$150) or daily tournament tickets ($160). Winners are notified in late July. 
    2027 Masters Ticket Details 
    • Application Window: June 1–20, 2026 (via tickets.masters.com).
    • Tournament Dates: April 5–11, 2027.
    • Cost (Estimated based on 2026):
      for tournament days;
      -
       for practice rounds.
    • Odds: Extremely low (estimated around 0.5%–1%). 
    How to Apply 
    1. Create an Account: Register on the official Masters website before the application window opens
      .
    2. Apply for Tickets: Only one application per person is allowed, but you can apply for multiple days.
    3. Wait for Selection: Winners are selected via a random drawing in July. 
    Other Ways to Attend 
    • ANWA and DCP: Apply separately for the Augusta National Women's Amateur (April 3, 2027) and Drive, Chip and Putt National Finals (April 4, 2027) for more chances to visit.
    • Warning on Third-Party Tickets: Augusta National is the only authorized source. Tickets bought elsewhere are often invalid, and reselling within 2,700 feet of the course is illegal.

    When can I apply for 2027 Masters tickets?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Applications for 2027 Masters Tournament tickets (April 5-11, 2027) open on June 1, 2026, and close on June 20, 2026. Fans must enter the official random selection lottery at tickets.masters.com to purchase tickets at face value. 
    Key details for 2027 ticket applications: 
    • Where to Apply: Create or log in to an account at tickets.masters.com, augustanationalwomensamateur.com, or drivechipandputt.com.
    • Application Window: June 1–20, 2026.
    • Limits: Only one application per household, with a limit of 1–4 tickets per day requested.
    • Selection & Payment: Winners will be notified, and payment will be required in late July 2026. 
    It is highly recommended to set up an account before June 1, 2026, to ensure a smooth application process.
